blind.description: A classical ornate fireplace and mantel topped with a gilded mirror. The lower portion consists of a cream-colored marble mantelpiece featuring a tiered hearth base, scroll-carved pilasters, and an ornate relief carving above an open firebox with dark interior stone lining. Resting atop the mantel shelf is an elaborate baroque-style mirror framed in antique gold/bronze, detailed with side fluted columns and a decorative scrolled pediment, framing a light blue stylized reflective mirror surface. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and clean with no broken polygons or detached floating parts.
blind.from_above: A rectangular tiered profile showing the flat marble mantel top, the thick gold decorative mirror frame with two square corner posts and center scrolls, and the protruding lower hearth slab at the front.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly equal in height to the 5 ft 9 in figure, and about 3.5 to 4 feet wide.
